notes: A LODGEMENT THE BANK WILL NEVER CREDIT CAN NOW BE PUT TO REST WITHOUT REWRITING HISTORY — the mirror of last release's stale-cheque closure. Write the money back out with your own journal, then press CLOSE VIA JOURNAL on the lodgement (Cheque & Lodgement Register, Lodgements tab) and enter that journal's code. The register checks it is posted, credits the right bank account, and matches the lodgement to the pesewa before accepting it. Signed-off reconciliations keep the lodgement exactly as filed; only months after the journal's date stop carrying it, and reversing that journal reopens the lodgement automatically. THE SCREENS NOW SAY WHAT TO DO. Deleting a real cheque or lodgement warns that deleting erases it from PAST reconciliations too and points to Close via journal; Reinstate warns when a write-back you posted yourself already carries the money; the Dashboard's stale-cheque alert names both exits; and the User Guide gains a topic on cheques, lodgements and the bank reconciliation. TWO SILENT GAPS NOW SPEAK. A remitted cheque that never reached the register — a run interrupted at exactly the wrong moment — is named on the checks banner with its remedy, and Inventory carries the same stock-account-versus-register agreement check the Fuel screen has. ONE CORRECTION TO OWN PLAINLY: from 0.8.74 to 0.8.76 the sign-in screen introduced this product under the other edition's name and welcome copy. It reads MoRaj Ledger again, and the guard that watches the setup wizard's identity now watches the sign-in and start-up screens too, so that class of mistake fails our release checks rather than reaching you. THIS RELEASE CARRIES A DATABASE CHANGE that applies itself on first launch. Back up before installing, as always: Backup & Export, Back up now.
